mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1400K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1400K units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to lowered borrowing costs.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) drops below 3.2% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month, the combined signal of a tight labor market predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and stock performance
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly higher in triggered instances compared to non-triggered (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a quarter, signaling strong supply-side growth, leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward IC of INDPRO with SPX returns is below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real disposable personal income (RSAFS) growth exceeding 4% in a month, indicating robust consumer demand, predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between RSAFS and retail sales
failure_condition: SPX returns are not positively correlated with RSAFS growth over any 6-month window (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50 basis points in a quarter, signaling a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows no significant difference in SPX returns between easing and non-easing periods (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) shows consistent monthly growth, the joint labor market signal predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to impending monetary tightening.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower in triggered instances compared to non-triggered (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: GDP (GDPC1) growth exceeding 3.5% in a quarter, signaling strong aggregate demand, predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows no significant positive correlation between GDPC1 growth and SPX returns over any 1-year rolling window (p > 0.05).
